title: Cocentral Split Abelian Hopf Algebra Extensions from Crossed Cocycles
summary: We study cocentral algebra-split abelian Hopf algebra extensions over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero for a fixed action of a group on a finite abelian group. We describe the extension classes in terms of crossed families of normalized 2-cocycles and construct the obstruction to representing crossed families of cohomology classes by cocycles satisfying the crossed identity.
